content: ¿Tamarimta, taaris Apanllchichis siya? Nuw Wangtana siyaam yandaki ani. Isusoo Apanllee Wip kamanchintspa. Na mazinangantsa

Ndatuma tsapurunasee tinchu, urutari Apanllee yámandampani Apanllpatari taataranaya. Itaru, uwsha tputseem kinarangu, Apanllee iyaam izuuru yámandarangiya. Nuwaanasha kchipti parangi; nuwaana tsiyatku anoo mazinarangi; nuwaana kuwipti patatarangina. Ashiri siyaa kamanchintspa tina.

Ashirucha, Apanllee yámandampanee siyaa kamankuri, zureerutana atashina, watam kchiptarti paranginawa. Uwsha taarashipancha. Apanllpat urutamari taarangtaa, itaru Apanll waanaatsi taarashipani zanganeeru, taarashipansha tputseem kinarangiya. Iyaam taarasheemani urutamash panamaam kusarangiya. Ashiri iyma tayaspatampanni ichtaru mangooneeruni, waanaatsi taárash urutamash iyaam panarangu, iysha na urutamari taachiniya. Iy tamapariniya siy ashkachtamanaareesa, siyaptatam washunand taarashshee urutamash payuchinipa; mangis kisshaparee taatssa; mapiyshtich taamaama. Ashirucha, Isusoo Apanllee Wip siyaa kamankina.

Ashiriya, nuwsha Apanllee Wip kuk siyaa izuuru kamanchintspa. Apanll izuuru wanasircha; Apanll yutaritshishee nda pakchiyam chinakiya. Apanll 'sinpaz ashiru taakiya. Antaati Apanllish taap wanindareeja; nitaati yutaritshish min wanindareeja.
Ashiri iysha Apanllchichini yutaritshishish wand taakinaareeniya, waanariya Apanllchichtanicha atuni, ngutani ngichkuni atiniya; taarashini waptataja.

Itaru, Apanll tamara ashiritamani taakchuni, Isus Apanll Wip ursirpat yutaritshishireetsich tachingtariya. Ashkachuni, waptacha taakaniya. Washunand Apanllchichpatatich kisshapa ipunachchi. Ashiri Apanll tamara ashiritamani taayani tina.
Itaru, chiy waanari nuw yutarit taatareezi, yutaritshishiri ndunparee átuch, an ngutani ngichkuni atini.
Itaru, Apanllee zurampatarta chinakurini, ashiritaa uru pantsamaam taariya. Ashkachuni, yutaritshishireetsich Apanllee kamankachuch, uwsha Apanll izuuru tachingkiya. Sheeru, mapiychshtaya.
Watam Apanll mangeetsis tachingchintspa, táranguwa. Apanll ttsinsampancha. Ashiri yutaritshishireetsini Apanllee kamaneeni atina.

Itaru, chiy waanari nuw sirútamastaati yutarit taarangeezi átuch, Apanlleetssha wayangichirireem ínakaniya, watam Apanll iyaa tsapurunasshucheetsini ichingurus yutarittischa atuwa. Atuni an antaati Apanllee kuk kaapa izuuru mangoonkeezini atini nduni.
